title: Word Hunt (Scrambly)
objective: Find and swipe all target words hidden in the letter grid across three rounds to earn cash rewards.
controls: Touch and drag across adjacent letters horizontally, vertically, diagonally, or backwards to connect target words.
core_loop: Spot a target word in the grid -> swipe across its letters -> cross off the word and collect flying coins into your cash balance.
progression: Grid size and word length escalate each round: 4x4 (3-4 letter words), 5x5 (4-letter words with diagonals), and 6x6 (4-5 letter words including backwards swipes).
hook_idea: Round 3 climax with rapid backwards/diagonal swipes and coins showering to $6.60 at t=16.8-19.5s
